author: WantedDuck125
name: Duck Central Cogs
short: Custom cogs for a personal Redbot instance.
description: A small collection of custom cogs, beginning with a manual Twitch go-live announcement cog.
install_msg: Thanks for adding Duck Central Cogs! Install the go_live cog with `[p]cog install duckcentralcogs go_live`, then load it with `[p]load go_live`. See the README for setup.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-server configuration only: role ID, channel ID, Twitch URL, embed title, and default announcement message. It does not store personal user data.
